@camzam101 @DGBCommerce @DGBHodlers @dogecoin @DigiByteCoin @BillyM2k @elonmusk @camzam101 it’s ok to have different opinions, not everyone is going to agree on different issues. Being part of the community is about openly sharing thoughts and ideas even if others disagree.
